next_step: Run 2-week hosted API POC: streaming demo + tool-calling smoke tests; capture p99 latency, stream first-byte, and functional CRM integrations
notes: Background: Cascade Scripts builds outbound chat agents used by SDR teams to triage leads, send follow-ups, and schedule demos. Agents must perform live actions (CRM create/update, send email, create calendar event) via tool calls.
Why Redwood: impressed with streaming demo + function/tool calling in initial demo; AE highlighted unified runtime + path to Dedicated for steady throughput.

POC scope agreed: 2-week hosted API pilot. Objectives: (1) demonstrate stable streaming responses with sub-200ms first-byte in controlled test, (2) validate tool-calling reliability for create_contact/send_email/create_event, (3) measure p95/p99 latency and CPU/GPU cost per active agent.

Tech constraints: need webhooks for CRM writebacks, low-latency streaming to web client, and deterministic fallback when model variant unavailable. Must support structured tool schemas (OpenAPI-like) for safe actions.
Security: enterprise customers require SSO (SAML), audit logs for every tool call, and KMS-backed key management. Legal requested SOC2 evidence and simple data retention controls for PII.

Performance targets (customer): p99 request latency <250ms for synchronous calls; streaming first-byte <=120ms when available; end-to-end action completion under 1s for typical contact create+email flow (optimistic). POC will measure real numbers.

Cost sensitivity: running 50 active SDR agents initially. CFO asked for modeled TCO: acceptable hosted spend during POC but want Dedicated pricing options for predictable committed costs if unit economics look good.
Integration notes from call: "We need the agent to insert into our existing Gmail+Calendar flow and show 95% success on send_email events during tests" — Head of Product (R. Patel).

POC success criteria (agreed):
- Stable streaming with median first-byte <80ms in lab and p99 <200ms in 95% of test traffic.
- Tool-calls succeed end-to-end for 98% of test cases (CRM create/update, email send, calendar create) including audit log entries.
- Cost model: hosted cost estimate per active agent under $X during pilot; committed Dedicated quote within 30% of modeled spend for 12-month term.
Open questions / blockers: timing for SSO SAML test account, EU data residency requirements for portion of their book, and final Dedicated discount tiers for 12-month commit.

Next steps: provision test keys for hosted API, SE to provide sample tool schemas and example event webhooks, schedule POC kickoff week of 2026-03-16, finance to review Dedicated commitment pricing after pilot metrics.

Internal notes (AE/SE): capture traces for p99 requests and correlate with token lengths; consider enabling KV caching for repeated lead histories; prepare fallback routing policy to smaller quantized model for burst protection.
